refutes.statement: Conjecture LBO (K4.IND.LBO, k4/induct.md §4b; k = 3 setting: every agent other than w values three goods and is balanced, w values at most three goods): some run of Phase 1 with w last, some state of LB's upgrade loop (stopped anywhere; w not upgraded when top-heavy) and at most one LB⁺ rotation give a valid pre-allocation in which w is a valid owner (O) or a terminal with a free slot while another valid owner leaves a slot free (S). VARIANT (one ingredient dropped, 'every ingredient is needed'): without the LB⁺ rotation. Source: 'without the rotation, 3,608' misses at n = 4.

notes: A k = 3 instance (every agent has three goods; a connected k = 3 core of the listed certificate file), not in the k4_certs lists (which contain only cores with at least one 4-good agent). Values are rank weights 2..4 listed parallel to sets (induct_lbo.py work(): R_i = goods sorted by value). k4/induct.md gives only the counts; the instance is the first 'no witness' line of results/k4_induct_lbo_variants.log for this command. Re-run here with the branch's k4/induct_lbo.work(): the variant misses exactly the listed targets, and full LBO (--last --partial --rot) has a witness for every w.  Exact match (derived here, not stated in the source): core 16 of results/certs_lb_2_6.json.gz on main.
